correctness.rationale: Uniform conditional image subset plus surjection symmetry proves all falling-factorial moments. Conditioning on coverage monotonicity gives the collision bound; factorial inversion gives uniform Poisson error e²/r. Fixed r is binomial by vanishing coverage failure. Exact enumeration through n=6 provided 8633 assertions; infinite claims are proved analytically.
